checkpoint_domain_blocker: V10/V11 ranks use research checkpoint B (89eddb50...); downstream official release uses b716c7d8...; rerank V10/V11 from b716 is required before any ColorPCR authorization
raw_instance_membership_scope: (scan_id, side, object_id) -> raw row set only; never cross-scan identity, semantic feature, candidate ranking or solver feature
label_authority_definition: semantic/GT/selection/evaluation/posthoc labels are prohibited; the raw InSeg instance-id column is consumed only to recover same-scan object row membership and its SHA is recorded

rank_source_checkpoint.authority: V10 candidate ranks and V11 structural hypotheses only

downstream_official_release_checkpoint.authority: target official SGAligner release runtime; not the source of current V10/V11 ranks

deterministic_contract.rank_records: V10 rank records and object identities only
deterministic_contract.multi_object_hypotheses: V11 structural JSON only; exact stored order is authenticated then canonicalized by stable keys
deterministic_contract.surface_mapping: node index/object id to a unique raw InSeg object row set plus RGB; fail closed on zero or multiple mappings
deterministic_contract.preprocessing: filter matched members before world-origin 0.10 m voxel aggregation; builder saves raw and voxel10 prepared arrays only
deterministic_contract.coarsest_cap512: owned by the unchanged V13 official worker after repeated multi-level grid_subsample at the final coarsest stage; never applied directly after voxel10 by this builder
deterministic_contract.solver_execution: not part of this builder stage; current B-rank diagnostic outputs are prohibited as ColorPCR inputs; after b716 reranking, future forward and reverse ColorPCR must be independent processes

required_hypothesis_evidence: source/reference node indices and object ids
raw surface file hashes, row offsets, row indices and per-member hashes
filter-before-voxel raw unions and voxel10 prepared arrays
V10 source-cache recursive SHA/source closure and V11 canonical_input_sha256 recomputation
separate rank-source and downstream-release checkpoint identities
stop_conditions: cache or structural rank order mismatch
V10 source-cache, checkpoint chain, canonical object order/src_count, registration-surface or V11 canonical_input hash mismatch
attempt to treat checkpoint-B rank hypotheses as authoritative for the b716 official release
GT, label, posthoc, official92 or fallback field
any builder-side direct voxel10 FPS512/cap512 output
any attempt to execute or consume ColorPCR inputs while disabled=true
